message.content: Roger attended our first session at the Turning Point shelter. He reported feeling that he is not doing well and described a difficult time focusing on tasks. Roger stated that when his focus feels off, many other aspects of his life also feel disordered. The lack of focus is currently causing him significant distress. We discussed his history of substance use, but Roger noted that he has no current desire to use because it creates too many problems for him. He is in the process of collecting disability benefits for a traumatic brain injury. His anxiety and depression scores were recorded as 2 and 3, which are considered manageable levels. We utilized cognitive restructuring to address the link between poor focus and overall distress. Roger responded by acknowledging the connection and agreeing to practice grounding techniques during this period.
